honesty_labels.fps_note: P99 is the headline metric per WO-P5-RELEASE decision 4. FPS samples are 1/dt between successive publish+draw cycles; sandbox Python is interpreted so absolute FPS is low; the COMPARISON across backends is the signal.
honesty_labels.alloc_note: alloc_bytes_per_frame measured via tracemalloc (Python-side only; ctypes-level copies are not counted). C and D assert 0; RED on violation.
honesty_labels.gc_note: gc.get_stats() returns collection counts per generation; pause duration is not tracked by Python's gc module. gc_pause_ms_total is approximated as 0 with a note; gc_pause_count is the real metric.
honesty_labels.cpu_note: cpu_percent = (process_time delta / wall_time delta) * 100. Captures interpreter + GC overhead.
honesty_labels.cold_start_note: cold_start_ms = time from backend __init__ to first publish return. C includes ctypes.CDLL load + weft_init; D includes ctypes buffer allocation; A/B are pure-Python allocations.
